gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.6114 42.733737)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1100 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

higher_points AS (

    AND (ST_DumpAsPolygons(r.rast, 1)).val > 1100
),
nearest_high_point AS (
  SELECT
    geom
  FROM
    higher_points
  ORDER BY
    park_point.geom <-> geom
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ST_Distance(park_point.geom, nearest_high_point.geom) AS distance_meters
FROM
  park_point,
  nearest_high_point;
